desc: Netherworld skills (effects active while a netherworld is dropped/called into battle). Pool table.

fields.name: id
fields.desc: netherworld skill id: 1000.. persistent, 2000.. end-of-turn, 3000.. on-call

fields.name: unk_02C
fields.desc: 0/1: 1 for 28 generic stat/bonus skills (Sandstorm, EXP Up, Auto HP Recovery...), 0 for special/Baal/dummy ones; maybe "can appear randomly"

fields.name: trigger
fields.desc: when the skill acts (matches dummy row names 永続/終了時/起動時)

fields.name: effect_type
fields.desc: 1..4; 2 = stat/resistance modifier, 3 = gain-rate bonus (EXP/Mana/HL...), 1 = damage/one-shot, 4 = special

fields.name: target
fields.desc: 6 for most (all units), 3 = allies (Baal debuffs), 1 = ally single?, 4 = enemies

fields.name: param
fields.desc: affected parameter: 1 HP, 2 SP, 9 MOV, 10 JMP, 12 throw range, 16 fire/17 wind/18 water resist, 50 EXP, 51 Mana, 52 HL, 53 weapon mastery, 54 skill EXP, 55 class prof., 100 poison

fields.name: value
fields.desc: effect value (%, or flat for MOV/JMP/range); -1 = none

fields.name: value2
fields.desc: secondary value (Baal Berserk DEF -50, Final Trump Card 1)
